name: Ensemble
description: Both hands playing different parts: the left hand holds down an arpeggiated chord progression while the right plays the melody over it, with speed, spread and finger poses shaping the sound. Made for --synth.

mappings.name: Melody
mappings.comment: Right hand across the frame plays the tune. Move faster and it strikes harder.

mappings.name: Arpeggio
mappings.comment: Left hand picks the chord; raise it to play the arpeggio faster. Same key as the melody.

mappings.name: Brightness
mappings.comment: Raise the right hand to open the filter.

mappings.name: Resonance
mappings.comment: Spread the right fingers for more bite.

mappings.name: Volume
mappings.comment: Pinch the right hand to fade out.

mappings.name: Vibrato
mappings.comment: Left peace sign adds a wobble.

mappings.name: Sustain
mappings.comment: Left fist holds everything down into a wash.

mappings.name: Reverb Send
mappings.comment: Pull the hands apart for a bigger room.
